frames.title: Saw timber
frames.description: Front-right, sawing a thick timber laid on two low wooden sawhorses, one hand drives hand saw and other steadies timber. Preserve HUMAN taller lean proportions, brown hair and beard, plain linen shirt, not a dwarf.

frames.title: Nail planks
frames.description: Front-left, kneeling to hammer an iron nail into a short plank assembly, small toolbox beside him.

frames.title: Push supply barrow
frames.description: Right-side, pushing a single-wheel wooden barrow carrying sacks, full wheel and handles and boots visible.

frames.title: Carry timber
frames.description: Rear-left, carrying a short timber beam across shoulder, both hands steady it, full timber fits cell.

frames.title: Shovel soil
frames.description: Front-right, shoveling loose soil from a small pile, both hands on shovel and feet braced.

frames.title: Repair harness
frames.description: Left-side, seated at low bench repairing a leather harness with awl and thread, tools neatly arranged. Same HUMAN identity and proportions.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
